confidence_flags: Dense, irregular L-shaped plan with a curved stair-opening edge (near A3-A4, labelled 'ช่องบันได' on the matching upper-floor sheet หน้า20) and a separate curved bay/turret wall (near D-E, rows 3-5, matching the round bay window drawn on the architectural floor plan หน้า04/05). Every beam mark and its own printed level (e.g. 'B3(+0.40)') was read directly off the sheet, but not every interior/vertical beam segment and every small stub/void-hatch mark was resolved to an exact grid_ref pair at the same rigor as the clean perimeter runs. Treat this file as a representative, not exhaustive, trace — the full member SPECS (B1-B10A, B1', B3') are captured at much higher confidence on the dedicated section sheets (หน้า24/25) and join by element_id regardless of which plan occurrences were captured here.
warnings: CORRECTED 2026-08-24 โ€” span_length_m was ABSENT on every beam in this file (the key was missing entirely, not null). It has been computed from the grid master for every beam whose grid_ref_start and grid_ref_end are both exact, using the straight distance between the two grid intersections (Pythagoras where the beam is diagonal, so chamfered members get a real length too). This is pure computation from the grid per the ยง4 rule that span is calculated by code and never estimated by the model โ€” no position or mark was changed. Beams whose refs still carry a ~ are left without a span, because an approximate endpoint cannot yield an exact length.
'B1'' marks are a lighter/secondary beam family distinct from 'B1' (own section on หน้า25) — kept as a separate element_id, not merged into B1, per §0.3.

The curved beam near grid B7-C7 (marked 'B3' on both ends of the arc) forms a bay/oriel structure at the front of the house, matching the arched bay visible on the architectural elevation (หน้า07/09) and the arch-beam detail 'แบบขยาย_2' on หน้า26. It does not sit on a named or resolvable dummy grid position (no printed dimension chain locates its two spring points), so its grid_ref is left approximate ('~B7'/'~C7') rather than invented, per the standing 'never estimate pos_m' rule.

Several vertical/interior beams (B4, B5, B6, B6A, B10A) were read by mark and level from the sheet but their exact column-line position could not be pinned down with full confidence at 1:75 scale within the time available on this dense sheet — recorded with their nearest plausible grid line and flagged individually.

'S0'/'S1'/'S10' are slab markers with their own level callouts, recorded here as slab elements with approximate room-level grid_refs, satisfying op04's plan_slab subtask via markers embedded in the beam plan (this house has no separate slab-layout sheet) — same convention used in house 05 of this batch. 'S10' (S-one-zero) is a distinct mark from 'S1', not a transcription of it — double-checked per §10's SI/S1 warning.
